pulls.title: Standardize README headers, badges, and best-practices evidence
pulls.author: dcondrey
pulls.body:
## Summary

- standardize every Markdown README header with a left-aligned logo and adjacent title/description
- normalize badge geometry and category colors without hardcoding CI/security state colors
- add or validate repository-local OpenSSF best-practices evidence
- add only repository-supported CI, security, provenance, coverage, standards, and support badges

## Badge convention

Static badges use `flat-square` geometry and dark-slate `labelColor=20232a`. Metadata is blue, standards/affiliations are purple, and support/social badges use recognizable brand colors. CI, CodeQL, OpenSSF, coverage, SLSA, and other stateful badges retain service-generated state colors.

The evidence file is intentionally conservative: criteria not provable from tracked files or repository settings remain unknown or unmet rather than being overstated.
